# Copilot instructions

All rules for this repository live in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repo root.
Read and follow it before suggesting or making changes. In particular:

- Stay in scope; ask before dependency, schema, CI/infra, delete or public-API changes.
- Never open, print or log secrets or `.env` files.
- Type everything, document every function, and add tests with every change.
- Use Conventional Commits; never push to `main`.
- End every task with the report: Changes / Reasoning / Tests run / Risks / Follow-ups.
